title: Return-History Reserve on Payout Methods Re-Sends
content:
A Payout Methods method that has had transfers returned before keeps part of its held balance back when its returned money is re-sent. The re-send return-history reserve counts the returned transfers on the method less than 24 whole months before the re-send, the one being re-sent excluded: 40 percent when there are 2 or more such earlier returns, 20 percent when there is exactly one, and nothing when there is none. The reserve is a percentage of the held balance, kept for the next scheduled run.

## Reserve by return history

| Earlier returns on the method in the 24-month lookback (the one being re-sent not counted) | Return-history reserve, percent of the held balance |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 40 percent |
| Exactly 1 | 20 percent |
| None | Nothing |

## How the returns are counted

- **Which returns.** Return entries on this method's payout ledger, by return date. Returns on the host's other methods are not counted.
- **Lookback.** Returns dated less than 24 whole months before the re-send. A return dated exactly 24 whole months before the re-send is outside the lookback.
- **The return being re-sent.** It is not counted: a method whose only return in the lookback is the one being re-sent has no earlier return.

## Hypothetical cases (re-send dated 2026-08-20)

| Returns on the method | Earlier returns counted | Reserve |
|---|---|---|
| The return being re-sent only | 0 | Nothing |
| The return being re-sent, and one on 2025-03-02 | 1 | 20 percent |
| The return being re-sent, one on 2025-03-02 and one on 2024-08-21 | 2 | 40 percent |
| The return being re-sent, and one on 2024-08-20 (exactly 24 whole months earlier) | 0 | Nothing |

**Hypothetical amount.** On an imagined held balance of USD 4215.00 with one earlier return in the lookback, the return-history reserve is 20 percent of USD 4215.00, USD 843.00, kept for the next scheduled run.
